facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 5 February 2025, on the report of the minister of territorial administration and decentralisation, adopted the texts creating the Agence nationale de Sécurisation des actes d'état civil, whose main missions are to identify and put in place electronic means for managing civil status acts, to design and securely produce them and to authenticate them; it replaces the CTDEC, faulted for insufficient synergy between civil status actors and inadequate securing of acts against forgery.
